> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

A bounded current official-source comparison found a Kayn CMS identifier conflict; no runtime catalog or accepted match history has been changed.

The official gallery page explicitly lists French and German alternate locales. At the recorded 2026-10-18 UTC acquisition times, both supported locale API responses returned `ogn-189-000` / `OGN-189/000` for Kayn, Unleashed (1409 actual rows / 1417 declared). A fresh English response returned the existing canonical `ogn-189-298` / `OGN-189/298`, no `/000` record, and the same 1408 whole rows / 1416 declared as the earlier English observation. The original 8-entry count gap remains open.

All three records point to the identical official image. Actual full-resolution visual inspection confirms the footer `OGN · 189/298`, Kayn / UNLEASHED, and costs/stats6/1/6. ImageSHA256: `003990d7789021298797befcc65c37b36a91d74b53dd593c477e55f613455cc2`. Current official CN API31419 remains OGN·189/298 / 凯隐·巨镰奔扬, unchanged. Publication/effective dates for the global duplicate are unavailable; imageLast-Modified is not assumed to be a publication date.

Sources: [English API](https://content.publishing.riotgames.com/publishing-content/v2.0/public/channel/riftbound_website/list/riftbound_gallery_cards?locale=en_US&limit=2000&from=0), [French API](https://content.publishing.riotgames.com/publishing-content/v2.0/public/channel/riftbound_website/list/riftbound_gallery_cards?locale=fr_FR&limit=2000&from=0), [German API](https://content.publishing.riotgames.com/publishing-content/v2.0/public/channel/riftbound_website/list/riftbound_gallery_cards?locale=de_DE&limit=2000&from=0), [shared official image](https://cmsassets.rgpub.io/sanity/images/dsfx7636/game_data_live/a1ce0e784264748f170bebb3b26a09a7f55efe0f-744x1039.png?accountingTag=RB).

Keep this as a separate source-identity/applicability obligation. Do not silently normalize `/000`, infer a new physical printing, infer a temporal publication change from another locale, close the English8 gap, or promote one image to all Kayn printings/semantics. The four existing temporal-source delta records remain intact. Original gzipped responses, hashes, acquisition timestamps, exact record dictionaries and visual evidence are retained in `var/qa/copied-duel-insight-20261019/` and will be published as bounded repository evidence with this batch. Whole audit remains active / NOT READY.
title: Track regional Kayn CMS /000 identity conflict against the official /298 card image
